recognize_zh: 這是一張 G 帶染色體核型圖而非形態學影像；可見第 19 號染色體似有四條、第 22 號似有三條，屬於高二倍體異常，數目變化（如 +19、+21、+22）常見於急性巨核母細胞白血病。
features: G-banded karyogram arranged by chromosome pairs 1-22 plus sex chromosomes
Chromosome 19 group appears to contain four homologs (apparent tetrasomy 19)
Chromosome 22 group appears to contain three homologs (apparent trisomy 22)
Sex chromosomes appear to be one X and one small Y-like chromosome
Low image resolution precludes band-level assessment of structural rearrangements
describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It appears to show a hyperdiploid clone with extra copies of chromosome 19 (four homologs) and chromosome 22 (three homologs), with XY sex chromosomes; the low resolution does not permit reliable identification of subtle structural abnormalities. Numerical gains such as +19, +21 and +22 are recurrent in acute megakaryoblastic leukemia, and the karyotype should be interpreted together with morphology, immunophenotype (CD41/CD61) and molecular studies.
